Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 9

“And many other heroes, skilled in various weapons, all experts in warfare, who have given up their lives for my sake.”

Duryodhana closes his roster with a broader claim — that countless warriors are ready to die for him personally. Telling that he frames their loyalty as owed to him, not to any cause of justice.
